import Wrapped4.NearBinary
open Wrapped4
def Research001 : Prop := ∀ (n : Nat), 10 ≤ n → ∀ (a b x : Nat),
  applyWrappedOps (twoUniqueFlipOps n) ([a, b] ++ List.replicate (n - 2) x) =
    List.replicate (n - 2) x ++ [b, a]

import Wrapped4.NearBinary
open Wrapped4
def Research002 : Prop := ∀ (n : Nat), 10 ≤ n → ∀ (a b x : Nat),
  leftWrapped4 (n - 3) ([a, b] ++ List.replicate (n - 2) x) =
    [x, b] ++ List.replicate (n - 3) x ++ [a]

import Wrapped4.NearBinary
open Wrapped4
def Research004 : Prop :=
  applyWrappedOps (twoUniqueFlipOps 5) ([0, 1] ++ List.replicate 3 2) =
    List.replicate 3 2 ++ [1, 0]

import Wrapped4.NearBinary
open Wrapped4
def Research005 : Prop := ∀ (n : Nat) (a b x : Nat),
  applyWrappedOps (twoUniqueFlipOps n) ([a, b] ++ List.replicate (n - 2) x) =
    List.replicate (n - 2) x ++ [b, a]

import Wrapped4.NearBinary
open Wrapped4
def Research006 : Prop :=
  applyWrappedOps [Op.left 9, Op.left 8] ([0, 1] ++ List.replicate 10 2) =
    List.replicate 10 2 ++ [1, 0]

import Wrapped4.NearBinary
open Wrapped4
def Research007 : Prop := ∀ (n : Nat), 10 ≤ n → ∀ (a b x : Nat),
  leftWrapped4 (n - 4) ([x, b] ++ List.replicate (n - 3) x ++ [a]) =
    [x, b] ++ List.replicate (n - 4) x ++ [a, x]

import Wrapped4.NearBinary
open Wrapped4
def Research008 : Prop := ∀ (n : Nat), 10 ≤ n → ∀ (a b x : Nat),
  rightWrapped4 (n - 2) ([x, b] ++ List.replicate (n - 4) x ++ [a, x]) =
    List.replicate (n - 2) x ++ [b, a]

import Wrapped4.NearBinary
open Wrapped4
def Research009 : Prop := ∀ n : Nat, (twoUniqueFlipOps n).length = 3

import Wrapped4.NearBinary
open Wrapped4
def Research010 : Prop := ∀ (n : Nat) (a b x : Nat),
  leftWrapped4 (n - 3) ([a, b] ++ List.replicate (n - 2) x) =
    [x, b] ++ List.replicate (n - 3) x ++ [a]

import Wrapped4.NearBinary
open Wrapped4
def Research011 : Prop := ∀ (n : Nat), 10 ≤ n → ∀ (a b x : Nat),
  applyWrappedOps (twoUniqueFlipOps n) ([a, b] ++ List.replicate (n - 2) x) =
    [a, b] ++ List.replicate (n - 2) x
